summaryZh: Head 实验室研究 caveolin 蛋白及膜脂筏如何调控突触信号、神经可塑性与神经保护，涉及阿尔茨海默病、肌萎缩侧索硬化症和神经损伤。实验室使用 AAV 介导的基因治疗、人 iPSC 来源神经元及神经退行性疾病动物模型，探索神经修复和功能保护。
researchQuestions: caveolin 及膜脂筏如何调控突触信号与神经可塑性？
methods: 人 iPSC 来源神经元
神经退行性疾病动物模型

evidence.quote: I am a Research Career Scientist awardee at the VA San Diego Healthcare System and hold a dual appointment as a Professor of Anesthesiology at UCSD.

I have 17 years of experience testing AAV-mediated gene therapy technologies and interventions that afford neuroprotection against trauma and neurodegenerative disease models of Alzheimer’s disease (AD) and amyotrophic lateral sclerosis (ALS).

Specifically, I research caveolin (Cav), a scaffolding protein in membrane/lipid rafts (MLRs), that regulates synaptic signaling and neuroplasticity in neuronal models (human neurons derived from iPSCs, animal models of neurodegeneration such as AD and ALS).
